title: Entering the Sect
summary: Wang Lin, having failed the ladder, throws himself off a cliff, and the Heaven Defying Bead pulls him into its dream space, where the trapped soul of Situ Nan is waiting. Situ Nan tries to take his body but cannot, and scorns his poor aptitude. Moved by his perseverance, Huang Long accepts Wang Lin as a grey-robed registered disciple, and Zhang Kuang escorts him to the sect. There Wang Lin shares quarters with Zhang Hu and is given the hated water-carrying chores. He finds that water soaked in the bead heals him, and that dew upgrades its water attribute. Situ Nan begins teaching him: Wang Lin reaches level 1 Qi Condensation, learns the Gravity Technique, and is taken as a disciple by Elder Sun Dazhu. The episode ends as the bully Senior Brother Liu Shulang attacks Zhang Hu, and Wang Lin steps in.
events: Wang Lin wakes in the bead's dream space and meets Situ Nan, trapped there for 1,000 years
Situ Nan fails to take over Wang Lin's mortal body
Huang Long makes an exception and accepts Wang Lin as a registered disciple; Zhang Kuang takes him to the sect
Zhang Hu befriends him; Wang Lin is given the red water-carrying mission card
Wang Lin discovers the bead's healing water and upgrades its water attribute with dew
Liu Shulang beats Wang Lin over 'hidden treasure'; Situ Nan agrees to teach him
Wang Lin reaches level 1 Qi Condensation and learns the Gravity Technique; Elder Sun Dazhu takes him as a disciple
Liu Shulang tries to kill Zhang Hu and Wang Lin intervenes
cultivation: Wang Lin reaches level 1 Qi Condensation. Inside the bead's space, time runs ten times faster than outside. Situ Nan lists the seven steps: Qi Condensation, Foundation Establishment, Core Formation, Nascent Soul, Soul Formation, Soul Transformation, Ascendant.
